report:
C1: Bond price: the five-year bond is priced at 104.4912925031211 per one hundred of face amount. This is above par, so the bond trades at a premium.
C2: Modified duration: the bond's modified duration is 4.410689847574737. This is the approximate percentage change in price for a one percentage point parallel move in yield.
C3: DV01: the dollar value of a one basis point move in yield is 0.046087870605298065 per one hundred of face amount. This is the price change expected when the yield rises or falls by one basis point.
C4: Convexity: the bond's convexity is 22.92314562534249. Convexity is positive, so duration alone overstates price losses when yields rise and understates price gains when yields fall.
